clauses.body: This Distribution Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} by and between {{ACCT_LEGAL_ENTITY}} ("Label") and {{ACCT_COUNTERPARTY}} ("Artist").

THIS DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is made and entered into effective {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}}, by and between {{ACCT_LEGAL_ENTITY}}, a company organized and existing under the laws of the state in which it is incorporated ("Distributor"), and {{ACCT_COUNTERPARTY}} ("Content Provider").
This License Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} by and between {{ACCT_LEGAL_ENTITY}} ("Licensor") and {{ACCT_COUNTERPARTY}} ("Licensee").

This Recording Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} by and between {{ACCT_LEGAL_ENTITY}} ("Label") and {{ACCT_COUNTERPARTY}} ("Artist"), for the purpose of producing sound recordings as described herein.

This Publishing Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} by and between {{ACCT_LEGAL_ENTITY}} ("Publisher") and {{ACCT_COUNTERPARTY}} ("Writer"), for the administration and exploitation of musical compositions.

This Film Distribution Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} by and between {{ACCT_LEGAL_ENTITY}} ("Distributor") and {{ACCT_COUNTERPARTY}} ("Producer"), for the distribution and exploitation of the motion picture currently entitled "{{OPP_FILM_TITLE}}" (the "Picture").

This Talent Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} by and between {{ACCT_LEGAL_ENTITY}} ("Producer") and {{OPP_TALENT_NAME}}, professionally known as such, furnishing services through {{ACCT_COUNTERPARTY}} ("Artist"), for services in connection with the production currently entitled "{{OPP_FILM_TITLE}}".
This Non-Disclosure Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} by and between {{ACCT_LEGAL_ENTITY}} ("Disclosing Party") and {{ACCT_COUNTERPARTY}} ("Receiving Party").
The rights granted herein shall extend worldwide, excluding territories listed in Exhibit A.
The Territory for purposes of this Agreement shall be throughout the world, subject to any exclusions set forth in the attached Schedule.
The rights and licenses granted under this Agreement shall apply in all territories and countries of the world without limitation.
The rights granted herein shall be limited to the United States of America and Canada.
The rights granted herein shall be limited to {{OPP_TERRITORY}}.
The initial term of this Agreement shall be {{OPP_TERM_LENGTH}} year(s) from the Effective Date.
This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue for a period of {{OPP_TERM_LENGTH}} year(s) thereafter, unless earlier terminated in accordance with the provisions hereof.

This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one (1) year periods unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the expiration of the then-current term.
This Agreement shall not automatically renew. Any extension of the Term shall require a written amendment signed by both parties.
Label shall pay Artist a non-refundable advance of ${{OPP_ADVANCE_AMOUNT}} (the "Advance"), recoupable from Artist's share of Net Receipts.

Upon execution of this Agreement, Company shall pay to Artist an advance in the amount of ${{OPP_ADVANCE_AMOUNT}} (the "Advance"). The Advance shall be fully recoupable against royalties earned hereunder but shall not be returnable to Company under any circumstances.
No advance shall be payable under this Agreement.
The standard royalty rate shall be {{OPP_ROYALTY_RATE}}% of Net Receipts as defined herein.
The backlog catalog rate shall be {{OPP_BACK_CATALOG_RATE}}% to Label for a period not to exceed {{OPP_TERM_LENGTH}} years from the Effective Date.
For new releases during the Term, the royalty rate shall be {{OPP_NEW_RELEASE_RATE}}% of Net Receipts.
Royalty statements and payments shall be rendered within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar quarter.
Royalty statements and payments shall be rendered within sixty (60) days following the end of each calendar quarter.
Royalty statements and payments shall be rendered within ninety (90) days following the end of each calendar quarter.
The rights granted herein are exclusive. Artist shall not grant any third party the rights set forth in this Agreement during the Term.
The rights granted herein are non-exclusive. Artist retains the right to grant similar rights to third parties.
Label shall have the right to sublicense the rights granted herein to affiliated entities and authorized sub-distributors.

Either party may terminate this Agreement upon {{OPP_TERMINATION_PERIOD}} days' prior written notice to the other party. Upon termination, all rights granted herein shall revert to the granting party.

This Agreement may be terminated by either party upon not less than {{OPP_TERMINATION_PERIOD}} days' advance written notice. Following such termination, all exploitation rights shall immediately cease and all intellectual property rights shall revert to the original rights holder.
Following termination, Label shall have a sell-off period of {{OPP_SELL_OFF_PERIOD}} months to exploit existing inventory and fulfill pending orders.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California, without regard to its conflicts of laws provisions.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflicts of laws provisions.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of {{OPP_GOVERNING_LAW}}.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

___________________________
{{ACCT_LEGAL_ENTITY}}
By: ___________________________
Name:
Title:
Date:

___________________________
{{ACCT_COUNTERPARTY}}
By: ___________________________
Name:
Title:
Date:

Producer shall accord Artist star billing in the main titles of the Picture, on a separate card, in a size of type no less than one hundred percent (100%) of the title of the Picture. Artist's name shall also appear in all paid advertising in which any other cast member is mentioned, in first position.

Producer shall accord Artist featured billing in the end titles of the Picture, in a size no less than fifty percent (50%) of the title. Credit shall be on a shared card. Inclusion in paid advertising is at Producer's sole discretion.

Artist is a member in good standing of the Screen Actors Guild-American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (SAG-AFTRA). This Agreement is subject to all applicable SAG-AFTRA collective bargaining agreements, including minimum compensation, working conditions, and residual obligations.

Residual payments shall be made in accordance with the applicable SAG-AFTRA Basic Agreement schedule. All residuals shall be computed and paid based on the applicable formula for the medium of exhibition, including but not limited to theatrical, free television, pay television, streaming/new media, and supplemental markets.

In lieu of residual payments, Artist shall receive a one-time buyout payment as set forth in the Compensation section. This buyout covers all exhibitions and re-exhibitions of the production in all media now known or hereafter devised, in perpetuity.

In addition to the fixed compensation set forth above, Artist shall receive {{OPP_BACKEND_POINTS}}% of one hundred percent (100%) of the net profits of the Picture, as defined in Exhibit D (the "Net Profits Definition"), reducible for each additional net profit participant but not below fifty percent (50%) of the original amount.

The initial series order shall consist of {{OPP_EPISODE_COUNT}} episodes. Each episode shall have a running time of approximately forty-four (44) minutes, exclusive of commercials. Production of each episode shall be completed within the production schedule set forth in Exhibit E.

Artist shall receive a per-episode fee of ${{OPP_EPISODE_FEE}} for each episode in which Artist renders services. Payment shall be due within ten (10) business days following completion of Artist's services for each episode.

Artist shall receive a day rate of ${{OPP_DAY_RATE}} per day for each day of principal photography in which Artist renders services. Overtime, if any, shall be compensated at one and one-half (1.5) times the applicable hourly rate.
All synchronization uses of the Masters shall require Artist's prior written approval on a per-use basis.
Mechanical royalties shall be split {{OPP_MECHANICAL_SPLIT}} between Label and Artist.
Performance royalties shall be split {{OPP_PERFORMANCE_SPLIT}} between Label and Artist.
Synchronization licensing income shall be split {{OPP_SYNC_SPLIT}} between Label and Artist.
Label shall retain an administration fee of {{OPP_ADMIN_FEE}}% of gross receipts.
Artist/Writer is affiliated with {{OPP_AFFILIATION}} as their Performing Rights Organization (PRO).
Label shall have the option to extend this Agreement for one (1) additional album option period.
Artist grants Label exclusive recording rights during the Term. Artist shall not record or authorize the recording of any performances for any third party without Label's prior written consent.
Controlled composition provisions shall apply. Mechanical royalties for compositions written or controlled by Artist shall be calculated at the statutory rate reduced to three-quarters (75%).
The opportunity scope includes distribution and synchronization usage rights for the Catalog as defined in Exhibit B.
The scope of this Agreement includes synchronization rights, permitting the use of the Masters in audiovisual works subject to Label's approval of each usage.
Label shall have the right to manufacture, distribute, and sell merchandise bearing Artist's name, likeness, and approved artwork, subject to Artist's prior written approval of each item.

Artist shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Label, its officers, directors, employees, and agents from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to any breach of Artist's representations, warranties, or obligations under this Agreement, including but not limited to any claim that the Works infringe upon any third party's intellectual property rights.

Each party (the "Indemnifying Party") shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other party (the "Indemnified Party"), its affiliates, officers, directors, employees, and agents from and against any and all third-party claims, actions, suits, proceedings, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to any breach by the Indemnifying Party of its representations, warranties, covenants, or obligations under this Agreement.

Producer shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Performer, Performer's agents, representatives, and assigns from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to (a) any act or omission of Producer in connection with the production of the Picture, (b) any use of Performer's services, name, voice, or likeness in a manner not authorized under this Agreement, or (c) any breach of Producer's representations, warranties, or obligations hereunder.

IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNTS ACTUALLY PAID OR PAYABLE BY LABEL TO ARTIST UNDER THIS AGREEMENT DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTH PERIOD IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO SUCH LIABILITY. IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES.

Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, the maximum aggregate liability of Producer to Performer under this Agreement shall not exceed {{LIABILITY_CAP_AMOUNT}}. This limitation shall not apply to (a) Producer's indemnification obligations, (b) willful misconduct or gross negligence, or (c) breach of confidentiality obligations.

Neither party shall be liable for any failure or delay in performing its obligations under this Agreement where such failure or delay results from any cause that is beyond the reasonable control of such party, including but not limited to acts of God, fire, flood, earthquake, war, terrorism, strikes, lockouts, governmental actions, or other force majeure events. The affected party shall promptly notify the other party and use commercially reasonable efforts to mitigate the effects of such event.

Neither party shall be liable for any failure or delay in performance under this Agreement to the extent caused by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including without limitation: acts of God, natural disasters, pandemics, epidemics, public health emergencies, government orders or restrictions, war, terrorism, civil unrest, labor disputes, supply chain disruptions, cyberattacks, or interruption of utilities or telecommunications. If a force majeure event continues for more than {{FORCE_MAJEURE_PERIOD}} consecutive days, either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice to the other party.

Each party agrees that all financial terms, business strategies, proprietary information, and other confidential information disclosed by either party in connection with this Agreement ("Confidential Information") shall be kept strictly confidential and shall not be disclosed to any third party without the prior written consent of the disclosing party, except as may be required by law or court order. This obligation of confidentiality shall survive the termination or expiration of this Agreement.

Each party (the "Receiving Party") agrees that all Confidential Information received from the other party (the "Disclosing Party") shall be held in strict confidence for a period of {{CONFIDENTIALITY_PERIOD}} following the termination or expiration of this Agreement. "Confidential Information" means any non-public information, whether written, oral, electronic, or visual, that is designated as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential. The foregoing obligations shall not apply to information that (a) is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the Receiving Party, (b) was known to the Receiving Party prior to disclosure, (c) is independently developed without use of Confidential Information, or (d) is disclosed pursuant to a valid court order.

Producer shall obtain and maintain, at its sole cost and expense, the following insurance coverages throughout the production period: (a) commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than {{INSURANCE_AMOUNT}} per occurrence; (b) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law; (c) errors and omissions insurance; and (d) cast insurance covering key personnel. Producer shall name Performer as an additional insured on all such policies and shall provide certificates of insurance upon request.

Each party shall maintain commercially reasonable insurance coverage appropriate to its obligations under this Agreement, including commercial general liability insurance with coverage limits of not less than {{INSURANCE_AMOUNT}} per occurrence and {{INSURANCE_AGGREGATE}} in the aggregate.

Artist represents and warrants that: (a) Artist has the full right, power, and authority to enter into this Agreement and to grant the rights granted herein; (b) the Works are original and do not infringe upon the intellectual property rights of any third party; (c) there are no pending or threatened claims, litigation, or proceedings relating to the Works; and (d) Artist has not entered into any agreement that conflicts with the rights granted herein.

Label represents and warrants that: (a) Label is a duly organized entity in good standing under the laws of its jurisdiction of organization; (b) Label has the full right, power, and authority to enter into this Agreement and to perform its obligations hereunder; (c) the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement does not conflict with any other agreement to which Label is a party; and (d) Label shall perform the distribution services in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.

Producer represents and warrants that: (a) Producer owns or controls all rights in and to the Picture, including without limitation the complete chain of title; (b) the Picture does not infringe upon the rights of any third party, including copyrights, trademarks, rights of privacy, or rights of publicity; (c) Producer has obtained all necessary clearances, licenses, and permissions for all elements contained in the Picture, including music, footage, and name/likeness rights; and (d) Producer has complied with all applicable guild and union requirements.

Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach, termination, or invalidity thereof, shall be settled by binding arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association ("AAA") in accordance with its Commercial Arbitration Rules. The arbitration shall be conducted by a single arbitrator in {{ARBITRATION_VENUE}}. The arbitrator's decision shall be final and binding, and judgment upon the award rendered may be entered in any court having jurisdiction thereof. Each party shall bear its own costs and attorneys' fees in connection with the arbitration.

In the event of any dispute arising under this Agreement, the parties shall first attempt to resolve the matter through good faith mediation conducted by a mutually agreed-upon mediator. If the dispute is not resolved within thirty (30) days of the commencement of mediation, either party may submit the dispute to binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association. The mediation and any subsequent arbitration shall take place in {{ARBITRATION_VENUE}}.

Any legal action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in {{JURISDICTION_VENUE}}, and each party hereby irrevocably consents to the personal jurisdiction and venue of such courts. Each party waives any objection to venue, including on the grounds of forum non conveniens.

Each party acknowledges that a breach of this Agreement may cause irreparable harm to the other party for which monetary damages would be an inadequate remedy. Accordingly, in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity, the non-breaching party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief, specific performance, or other equitable remedies without the necessity of proving actual damages or posting any bond or other security.

EACH PARTY HEREBY IRREVOCABLY WAIVES, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, ANY RIGHT IT MAY HAVE TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY LEGAL PROCEEDING DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT OR THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY.

If during the Term of this Agreement, Label enters into any distribution agreement with any other artist or label on terms more favorable than those set forth herein with respect to royalty rates, advance amounts, or marketing commitments, Label shall promptly notify Artist and, at Artist's election, this Agreement shall be amended to include such more favorable terms.

Distributor agrees that the financial terms offered to Licensor under this Agreement shall be no less favorable than the financial terms offered by Distributor to any other licensor for comparable content in the same territory during the Term. If Distributor enters into an agreement with another licensor on more favorable financial terms for comparable content, Licensor shall have the right to elect to receive such more favorable terms.

During the Term and for a period of {{NON_COMPETE_PERIOD}} following the expiration or termination hereof, Artist shall not, directly or indirectly, enter into any agreement for the recording, production, or distribution of sound recordings with any other record label or distributor without the prior written consent of Label.

During the principal photography period and for a period of {{NON_COMPETE_PERIOD}} thereafter, Performer shall not render services as an actor, director, or producer in any other motion picture, television program, or commercial without the prior written consent of Producer, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld.

During the Term and for a period of {{NO_SOLICIT_PERIOD}} following termination or expiration hereof, neither party shall, directly or indirectly, solicit, recruit, or hire any employee, contractor, or artist of the other party who was involved in the performance of this Agreement.

Artist (or Artist's designated representative) shall have the right, upon {{AUDIT_NOTICE_DAYS}} days' prior written notice and no more than once per calendar year, to examine and audit the books, records, and accounts of Label relating to this Agreement at Label's principal place of business during regular business hours. If such audit reveals an underpayment of more than ten percent (10%) for any accounting period, Label shall promptly pay the shortfall and reimburse Artist for the reasonable cost of the audit.

Licensor shall have the right, upon reasonable notice and not more than once per fiscal year, to inspect, audit, and copy any and all books, records, accounts, and documentation relating to this Agreement maintained by Licensee, whether in physical or electronic form. Licensee shall provide reasonable access to its accounting systems and personnel for purposes of such audit. Licensee shall retain all records relating to this Agreement for a period of not less than {{RECORD_RETENTION_YEARS}} years following the expiration or termination hereof.

Neither party may assign, transfer, or delegate any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld. Any purported assignment in violation of this Section shall be null and void.

Neither party may assign this Agreement or any of its rights or obligations hereunder without the prior written consent of the other party; provided, however, that either party may assign this Agreement without consent (a) to an affiliate or subsidiary, (b) in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, or (c) to a successor entity. Any permitted assignee shall assume all obligations of the assigning party under this Agreement.

All master recordings created during the Term of this Agreement shall be owned by Label as "works made for hire" within the meaning of the United States Copyright Act. To the extent that any master recording does not qualify as a work made for hire, Artist hereby irrevocably assigns to Label all right, title, and interest in and to such master recording, including all copyrights therein, throughout the universe, in perpetuity.

All results and proceeds of Performer's services hereunder, including without limitation all performances, characterizations, and creative contributions, shall be considered "works made for hire" for Producer. To the extent any element does not qualify as a work made for hire, Performer hereby irrevocably assigns to Producer all right, title, and interest therein, including all copyrights and derivative work rights, throughout the universe, in perpetuity, in all media now known or hereafter devised.

variables.default: Producer owns all results and proceeds

clauses.body: Label shall be entitled to recoup the Advance and all other recoupable costs and expenses from Artist's share of Net Receipts. Until such time as all recoupable amounts have been fully recouped, Label shall retain one hundred percent (100%) of Artist's share of Net Receipts. Following full recoupment, Label shall pay Artist's share of Net Receipts in accordance with the royalty provisions set forth herein.

The Advance and all recording costs, video production costs, tour support, independent promotion expenses, and other recoupable costs (collectively, "Recoupable Amounts") shall be recoupable from Artist's royalties hereunder. Recoupable Amounts may be cross-collateralized across all Albums delivered under this Agreement, meaning that unrecouped amounts from one Album may be recouped from royalties earned by any other Album.

In the event of a Change of Control of Label (defined as any transaction or series of transactions resulting in a change of more than fifty percent (50%) of the ownership interests or voting power of Label), Artist shall have the right to terminate this Agreement upon {{CHANGE_CONTROL_NOTICE}} days' written notice, provided such notice is given within ninety (90) days following written notification of the Change of Control.

Label commits to the following minimum obligations during each year of the Term: (a) release of no fewer than {{MIN_RELEASES}} singles or other releases per year; (b) a minimum marketing spend of {{MIN_MARKETING_SPEND}} per release; and (c) digital distribution to no fewer than {{MIN_PLATFORMS}} major streaming platforms. Failure to meet these minimum commitments shall constitute a material breach of this Agreement.

Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement, the following provisions shall survive: (a) all accrued payment obligations; (b) all representations and warranties; (c) all indemnification obligations; (d) confidentiality obligations for a period of {{POST_TERM_PERIOD}} following termination; (e) audit rights for a period of {{AUDIT_SURVIVAL_PERIOD}} following termination; and (f) any other provisions that by their nature are intended to survive termination.

Licensor covenants that it will not institute, prosecute, or maintain any suit or action against Licensee or its affiliates, successors, or assigns for any claim arising out of the use of the Licensed Materials in accordance with the terms of this Agreement.

This Agreement is for the sole benefit of the parties hereto and their respective successors and permitted assigns, and nothing herein, express or implied, is intended to or shall confer upon any other person or entity any legal or equitable right, benefit, or remedy of any nature whatsoever under or by reason of this Agreement.

This Agreement, together with all exhibits, schedules, and addenda attached hereto, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous agreements, understandings, negotiations, and discussions, whether oral or written, between the parties. No amendment, modification, or waiver of any provision of this Agreement shall be effective unless in writing and signed by both parties.

All advances, recording costs, and other recoupable expenses under this Agreement may be cross-collateralized across all Albums and other recordings delivered hereunder, such that unrecouped amounts attributable to one Album may be recouped from royalties and other sums otherwise payable to Artist with respect to any other Album or recording under this Agreement or any other agreement between the parties.

Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, there shall be no cross-collateralization between Albums delivered under this Agreement. Each Album shall be accounted for separately, and unrecouped amounts attributable to one Album shall not be recouped from royalties earned by any other Album.

Upon the expiration of the Term (including any renewal periods), or upon the {{REVERSION_PERIOD}} anniversary of the initial commercial release of each Master Recording, whichever occurs later, all rights in and to the Master Recordings shall revert to Artist, free and clear of any encumbrances, subject only to Label's right to continue exploiting any units manufactured prior to the reversion date during a sell-off period as set forth herein.

Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, all catalog titles delivered hereunder shall revert to Artist within {{REVERSION_PERIOD}} of the effective date of termination, provided that (a) all advances have been fully recouped, and (b) Artist has provided written notice to Label specifying the catalog titles to be reverted. If advances have not been fully recouped, Label shall retain distribution rights until full recoupment or for an additional period not to exceed twenty-four (24) months, whichever occurs first.

Artist represents and warrants that all samples, interpolations, or other pre-existing musical elements incorporated into any Master Recording delivered hereunder have been properly cleared and licensed prior to delivery. Artist shall be solely responsible for obtaining and paying for all sample clearances. Artist shall provide Label with copies of all sample clearance agreements and licenses prior to commercial release. Any costs incurred by Label in connection with uncleared samples shall be recoupable from Artist's royalties.

Artist shall have full creative control over all aspects of the Master Recordings, including without limitation the selection of material, producers, studios, engineers, and other creative personnel. Label shall have the right to provide creative input and suggestions, but final creative decisions shall rest with Artist. Notwithstanding the foregoing, all Master Recordings must meet commercially reasonable technical and quality standards as determined by Label in good faith.

Label shall have approval rights over all material aspects of the Master Recordings, including without limitation the selection of compositions, producers, studios, musicians, and other creative elements. Artist shall submit all proposed recording plans to Label for approval prior to commencement of recording. Label's approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, delayed, or conditioned.

Artist shall pay to Producer a royalty equal to {{PRODUCER_POINTS}} percentage points (the "Producer Royalty") of the suggested retail list price of each unit of the applicable Master Recording sold, computed on the same basis as Artist's royalty hereunder. The Producer Royalty shall be payable from record one, without regard to recoupment of the recording fund or any other advance. Artist shall be solely responsible for the payment of the Producer Royalty, and the same shall not be an obligation of Label.

Producer shall receive a flat production fee of {{PRODUCER_FEE}} per Master Recording produced hereunder (the "Production Fee"). The Production Fee shall be payable fifty percent (50%) upon commencement of recording and fifty percent (50%) upon delivery and acceptance of the completed Master Recording. In addition, Producer shall receive a royalty of {{PRODUCER_POINTS}} percent of net receipts from exploitation of each Master Recording produced by Producer.

Artist shall deliver to Label fully mixed, edited, and mastered Master Recordings in a format acceptable to Label, including without limitation: (a) high-resolution WAV files at no less than 24-bit/48kHz; (b) all applicable metadata including ISRC codes; (c) liner notes, credits, and artwork; and (d) all necessary consents, clearances, and licenses. Each Master Recording shall be commercially satisfactory in Label's reasonable judgment.

Artist shall deliver all Master Recordings to Label via Label's designated digital asset management platform in the following formats: (a) lossless audio files (WAV or FLAC) at minimum 16-bit/44.1kHz; (b) Dolby Atmos mixes where applicable; (c) instrumental versions; (d) clean/radio edit versions where applicable; (e) complete metadata in DDEX format; and (f) high-resolution artwork at minimum 3000x3000 pixels. Delivery shall be deemed complete only upon Label's written acceptance.

Label shall provide Artist with tour support in an amount not to exceed {{TOUR_SUPPORT_AMOUNT}} per tour cycle (the "Tour Support"). Tour Support shall be recoupable from Artist's royalties hereunder. Artist shall provide Label with a proposed tour budget for approval prior to the commencement of each tour. Label shall have the right to approve all tour routing, venues, and support acts, such approval not to be unreasonably withheld.

Label shall allocate a marketing budget of no less than {{MARKETING_BUDGET}} per Album release (the "Marketing Budget") to be spent on digital marketing, playlist promotion, radio promotion, press, and other promotional activities as mutually agreed upon by the parties. Label shall provide Artist with a detailed marketing plan no later than sixty (60) days prior to each Album release date. Any unused portion of the Marketing Budget shall not carry over to subsequent releases.

Label shall have the right to produce or commission the production of audiovisual recordings ("Music Videos") embodying Artist's performances of the Master Recordings. The cost of producing Music Videos shall be charged fifty percent (50%) to Artist's royalty account as a recoupable expense and fifty percent (50%) to Label's account as a non-recoupable expense. Artist shall have mutual approval rights over the director, concept, and final edit of each Music Video.

For digital streaming exploitation, Artist shall receive {{STREAMING_RATE}} percent of Label's Net Receipts actually received from each digital service provider ("DSP"). "Net Receipts" for streaming purposes means the gross amounts actually received by Label from the applicable DSP, less any distribution fees, platform commissions, and applicable taxes. Label shall account to Artist for streaming royalties on a {{ACCOUNTING_FREQUENCY}} basis.

For physical product sales (including CDs, vinyl records, cassettes, and other tangible formats), Artist shall receive a royalty equal to {{PHYSICAL_RATE}} percent of the published price to dealers ("PPD") for each unit sold and not returned. Free goods, promotional copies, and cutout sales shall be royalty-free. Returns and credits shall be deducted from royalties in the accounting period in which they occur.

Label shall have the right to include Master Recordings on compilation albums, "best of" collections, and multi-artist releases, provided that (a) no more than {{MAX_COMPILATION_TRACKS}} Master Recordings are included on any single compilation, (b) Artist receives appropriate credit, and (c) the applicable royalty rate for compilation usage shall be the otherwise applicable royalty rate prorated by the ratio of Artist's Master Recordings to the total number of recordings on such compilation.

Label shall not couple any Master Recording delivered hereunder with recordings by other artists on any single, EP, or album release without Artist's prior written consent. For purposes of this Agreement, "coupling" means the inclusion of Artist's Master Recordings alongside recordings by other artists on the same release, excluding compilations, soundtracks, and curated playlists.

Label shall render to Artist semi-annual royalty statements within {{STATEMENT_DAYS}} days following the end of each accounting period (January 1 - June 30 and July 1 - December 31). Each statement shall set forth in reasonable detail the calculation of royalties due, including gross revenues, deductions, reserves for returns, and net amounts payable. Payment of any amounts shown to be due shall accompany each statement. Label shall maintain books and records sufficient to verify the accuracy of all royalty statements for a period of not less than three (3) years.

In the event that any member of the group departs during the Term (a "Leaving Member"), the remaining members shall continue to fulfill all obligations under this Agreement. The Leaving Member shall have no further rights to royalties accruing after the departure date, except for royalties attributable to Master Recordings on which the Leaving Member performed. Label shall have the option, but not the obligation, to enter into a separate recording agreement with the Leaving Member on terms to be negotiated in good faith.

Artist hereby grants to Label the right to use and authorize others to use Artist's name (both legal and professional), approved likeness, approved photographs, biographical material, and other identification of Artist in connection with the marketing, promotion, advertising, and exploitation of the Master Recordings and Artist's career, in any media now known or hereafter devised, throughout the Territory and during the Term. Such right shall not extend to the endorsement of any product or service without Artist's prior written consent.

In consideration of Label's investment in Artist's career, Artist agrees that Label shall receive {{ANCILLARY_SPLIT}} percent of Artist's Net Income derived from the following ancillary revenue streams during the Term: (a) live performance and touring; (b) merchandising; (c) endorsements and sponsorships; (d) fan clubs and direct-to-consumer sales; and (e) acting, modeling, and other entertainment-related activities. "Net Income" means gross receipts less direct, out-of-pocket costs and commissions paid to third-party agents and managers.

Performer agrees to render reasonable promotional services in connection with the Picture, including without limitation: (a) participation in press junkets, interviews, and media appearances; (b) attendance at the premiere and up to {{PROMO_EVENTS}} additional promotional events; (c) participation in electronic press kits and behind-the-scenes content; and (d) reasonable social media promotion. Producer shall reimburse Performer for all reasonable travel and accommodation expenses incurred in connection with promotional services.

Producer shall have the exclusive, irrevocable option to engage Performer's services for up to {{SEQUEL_OPTIONS}} sequel, prequel, or remake productions (each, a "Subsequent Production") based upon the Picture. Producer must exercise each option by written notice to Performer within {{OPTION_EXERCISE_PERIOD}} following the theatrical release of the immediately preceding production. The compensation for each Subsequent Production shall be no less than {{SEQUEL_INCREASE}} percent of the compensation paid for the immediately preceding production.

Performer shall have a right of first refusal to appear in any sequel, prequel, or remake of the Picture in a role comparable to Performer's role in the Picture. Producer shall notify Performer of any such production and provide Performer with {{ROFR_RESPONSE_DAYS}} business days to accept or decline the engagement. If Performer declines or fails to respond within such period, Producer may engage another performer for the role.

Performer grants to Producer the right to use Performer's name, voice, likeness, and biographical material in connection with the production, distribution, advertising, marketing, and exploitation of the Picture in all media now known or hereafter devised, throughout the universe, in perpetuity. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Producer shall not use Performer's name or likeness to imply Performer's endorsement of any product or service (other than the Picture itself) without Performer's prior written consent.

Director shall receive credit on a single card in the main titles of the Picture in the following form: "Directed by {{DIRECTOR_NAME}}" or "A {{DIRECTOR_NAME}} Film." Such credit shall appear in the main titles and in all paid advertising and publicity materials in which any other above-the-line talent receives credit, in a size of type no less than {{CREDIT_SIZE_PERCENT}} percent of the title of the Picture. All other aspects of credit, including placement, shall be at Producer's sole discretion.

Producer shall receive credit in the main titles and end credits of the Picture in the form: "Produced by {{PRODUCER_CREDIT_NAME}}." Such credit shall appear on a single card or shared card (with no more than two other producers) and in all paid advertising controlled by the distributing entity. Credit obligations shall be subject to any applicable guild requirements.

In addition to the fixed compensation set forth herein, Performer shall receive deferred compensation in the amount of {{DEFERMENT_AMOUNT}} (the "Deferment"), payable from the first net profits of the Picture. The Deferment shall be paid pari passu with all other deferments at the same level. "Net Profits" shall be defined in accordance with the standard net profit definition attached hereto as Exhibit A.

During the period of Performer's services, Producer shall provide Performer with the following: (a) first-class round-trip transportation (or private jet if travel exceeds {{FLIGHT_THRESHOLD}} hours); (b) a private, furnished apartment or suite at a {{HOTEL_RATING}}-star hotel or equivalent; (c) a dedicated driver and vehicle; (d) a private dressing room/trailer at the production location; (e) a personal assistant; and (f) a per diem of {{PER_DIEM_AMOUNT}} for each day on location away from Performer's principal residence.

Performer shall not be required to perform any nude scenes, scenes involving simulated sex acts, or scenes involving partial nudity unless specifically set forth in the Nudity Rider attached hereto as Exhibit B and signed by Performer. Producer shall provide Performer with at least {{NUDITY_NOTICE_DAYS}} days' written notice prior to filming any such scene. Performer shall have the right to have a closed set, limited to essential crew only, for the filming of any such scene. Performer shall have approval rights over the final edited version of any such scene.

Producer shall obtain a completion bond from a completion guarantor reasonably satisfactory to Distributor, guaranteeing the completion and delivery of the Picture in accordance with the approved budget, shooting schedule, and delivery specifications set forth in this Agreement. The cost of the completion bond shall be included in the approved budget. The completion guarantor shall name Distributor as a beneficiary of the completion bond.

Producer shall obtain and maintain errors and omissions ("E&O") insurance from an insurer reasonably satisfactory to Distributor, with coverage limits of not less than {{EO_COVERAGE}} per claim and {{EO_AGGREGATE}} in the aggregate, for a period of not less than {{EO_PERIOD}} years from the date of initial delivery. The policy shall name Distributor as an additional insured and loss payee.

Producer represents and warrants that Producer owns or controls all rights necessary for the production, distribution, and exploitation of the Picture, and that Producer can provide a complete and unbroken chain of title from the original author(s) of the underlying literary or dramatic material through to Producer. Producer shall deliver to Distributor a complete chain of title documentation package, including copyright registrations, option/purchase agreements, writer agreements, and a title opinion letter from a qualified entertainment attorney.

Producer hereby grants to Distributor the exclusive right to distribute, market, and exploit the Picture in all media now known or hereafter devised, including without limitation: (a) theatrical exhibition; (b) non-theatrical exhibition; (c) home video (including DVD, Blu-ray, and digital sell-through); (d) pay-per-view and video-on-demand; (e) premium cable television; (f) free television; (g) streaming/SVOD platforms; (h) airline and hotel exhibition; and (i) all ancillary and subsidiary rights, throughout the Territory and during the Term.

Network shall have the exclusive option to order additional seasons of the Series for up to {{OPTION_SEASONS}} consecutive seasons beyond the initial season (each, an "Option Season"). Network must exercise each option by written notice to Producer no later than {{OPTION_DEADLINE}} days following the conclusion of the broadcast of the immediately preceding season. The per-episode license fee for each Option Season shall increase by {{SEASON_BUMP}} percent over the per-episode license fee for the immediately preceding season.

Network hereby orders a pilot episode of the Series (the "Pilot") at a license fee of {{PILOT_FEE}} and a deficit financing amount of {{PILOT_DEFICIT}}. Producer shall deliver the completed Pilot within {{PILOT_DELIVERY_DAYS}} days of the commencement of principal photography. Network shall have {{PILOT_PICKUP_DAYS}} days following delivery to notify Producer whether Network orders the Series to series.

Showrunner shall serve as the head writer and executive producer of the Series and shall have day-to-day creative and operational control of the Series, subject to Network's customary approval rights. Showrunner's compensation shall consist of: (a) a per-episode writing fee of {{WRITING_FEE}}; (b) an executive producer fee of {{EP_FEE}} per episode; (c) a series bonus of {{SERIES_BONUS}} payable upon pickup of each full season; and (d) {{BACKEND_POINTS}} percent of the modified adjusted gross receipts of the Series.

Network shall have the exclusive right to broadcast each episode of the Series within a window of {{WINDOW_PERIOD}} from the date of initial delivery (the "Broadcast Window"). During the Broadcast Window, no other exhibition of the episode shall be permitted in the Territory without Network's prior written consent. Following the expiration of the Broadcast Window, all exhibition rights shall revert to Producer, subject to any holdback periods set forth herein.

For each rerun or repeat broadcast of an episode of the Series on Network's linear channels, Network shall pay to Producer a rerun fee equal to {{RERUN_PERCENT}} percent of the initial per-episode license fee. Network shall be entitled to {{FREE_RERUNS}} free reruns of each episode within the first twelve (12) months following initial broadcast, after which the rerun fee shall apply.

Network shall have the exclusive right to make the Series available on its owned and operated streaming platform(s) within the Territory during the Term. The SVOD window shall commence {{SVOD_DELAY}} days following the initial linear broadcast of each episode. Network may sublicense streaming rights to third-party SVOD platforms only with Producer's prior written consent. Revenue from third-party SVOD licensing shall be split {{SVOD_SPLIT}} between Network and Producer.

Producer retains all international distribution rights outside the Territory. Network shall have a right of first negotiation for international distribution rights, exercisable within {{INTL_NEGOTIATION_DAYS}} days following Network's pickup of the Series. If the parties are unable to reach agreement within such period, Producer shall be free to negotiate with third parties, provided that Producer shall not accept terms less favorable than those last offered by Network without first offering Network the opportunity to match such terms.

The parties acknowledge and agree that all results and proceeds of Artist/Performer's services hereunder are and shall be considered "works made for hire" as that term is defined under the United States Copyright Act of 1976, as amended. All such works shall be the sole and exclusive property of the engaging party throughout the universe, in perpetuity, in all media and formats now known or hereafter devised.

To the extent that any of the results and proceeds of Artist's services hereunder are deemed "works made for hire," they shall be the property of Label. To the extent any such results and proceeds are not deemed works made for hire, Artist hereby irrevocably assigns all right, title, and interest therein to Label. Notwithstanding the foregoing, all rights in and to such works shall revert to Artist upon the expiration of the Term or {{REVERSION_PERIOD}} from the date of creation, whichever is later.

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Artist/Performer hereby irrevocably waives any and all moral rights (droit moral) in and to the Works/Picture, including without limitation the right of attribution, the right of integrity, and the right to object to derogatory treatment. In jurisdictions where moral rights may not be waived, Artist/Performer agrees not to assert such rights against the engaging party or its successors, assigns, or licensees.

Upon expiration of the Term, Label shall have a right of first refusal with respect to any new recording, distribution, or publishing agreement that Artist intends to enter into with a third party. Artist shall provide Label with written notice of the material terms of any proposed third-party agreement, and Label shall have {{ROFR_RESPONSE_DAYS}} business days from receipt of such notice to match such terms. If Label matches the terms within such period, the parties shall enter into a new agreement on such terms.

The parties acknowledge that {{KEY_PERSON_NAME}} (the "Key Person") is essential to the performance of Label's obligations under this Agreement. In the event that the Key Person ceases to be actively involved in the management of Artist's account or the oversight of this Agreement for any reason, Artist shall have the right to terminate this Agreement upon {{KEY_PERSON_NOTICE}} days' written notice, provided that such notice is given within ninety (90) days of the Key Person's departure or reassignment.

Producer's obligation to Performer hereunder is "pay-or-play," meaning that Producer shall be obligated to pay Performer the guaranteed compensation of {{GUARANTEED_AMOUNT}} regardless of whether Producer elects to utilize Performer's services. If Producer elects not to use Performer's services, Producer shall pay the guaranteed compensation within {{PAYORPLAY_DAYS}} days of written notice to Performer, and all of Performer's obligations under this Agreement shall be deemed fully discharged.

The term of this Agreement shall commence on {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} and shall continue for a period of {{TERM_MONTHS}} consecutive months thereafter (the "Initial Term"), unless earlier terminated in accordance with the provisions hereof.

The term of this Agreement shall commence on {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} and shall continue in perpetuity (i.e., for the full duration of copyright protection under applicable law, including all renewals and extensions thereof). For the avoidance of doubt, the rights granted herein are granted for the life of copyright throughout the universe.

The Initial Period of the Term shall commence on {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} and shall continue until twelve (12) months following the commercial release of the final Album required to be delivered during the Initial Period. Each Option Period, if exercised by Label, shall commence on the day following the expiration of the immediately preceding period and shall continue until twelve (12) months following the commercial release of the final Album required to be delivered during such Option Period.

The rights granted herein shall be limited to the member states of the European Union as constituted on the date of this Agreement, plus the United Kingdom, Norway, Switzerland, and Iceland (collectively, the "Territory").
The rights granted herein shall be limited to the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, including England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland (the "Territory").

The rights granted herein shall be limited to the Asia-Pacific region, including but not limited to Japan, South Korea, China (including Hong Kong and Macau), Taiwan, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, India, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, Philippines, and Vietnam (collectively, the "Territory").

The rights granted herein shall be limited to Latin America, including but not limited to Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Venezuela, and all Central American and Caribbean nations (collectively, the "Territory").

Label shall pay to Artist a non-refundable, but fully recoupable, advance in the aggregate amount of {{ADVANCE_TOTAL}}, payable in the following installments: (a) {{TRANCHE_1}} upon full execution of this Agreement; (b) {{TRANCHE_2}} upon commencement of recording; and (c) {{TRANCHE_3}} upon delivery and acceptance of the completed Masters. Each installment shall be subject to Artist's compliance with all terms and conditions of this Agreement.

Label shall pay to Artist an initial advance of {{INITIAL_ADVANCE}} upon execution of this Agreement. Additional performance-based advances shall be payable as follows: (a) an additional {{PERFORMANCE_ADVANCE_1}} if cumulative Net Receipts under this Agreement exceed {{REVENUE_THRESHOLD_1}} within the first twelve (12) months; and (b) a further {{PERFORMANCE_ADVANCE_2}} if cumulative Net Receipts exceed {{REVENUE_THRESHOLD_2}} within the first twenty-four (24) months.

Artist shall receive the following tiered royalty rates based on cumulative Net Revenue: (a) {{TIER_1_RATE}} percent on the first {{TIER_1_THRESHOLD}} in cumulative Net Revenue; (b) {{TIER_2_RATE}} percent on cumulative Net Revenue between {{TIER_1_THRESHOLD}} and {{TIER_2_THRESHOLD}}; and (c) {{TIER_3_RATE}} percent on all cumulative Net Revenue exceeding {{TIER_2_THRESHOLD}}.

Artist shall receive a flat royalty rate of {{FLAT_RATE}} percent of Net Receipts from all exploitation of the Works during the Term. "Net Receipts" shall mean the gross amounts actually received by Label from the exploitation of the Works, less any distribution fees charged by third-party distributors, platform commissions, applicable taxes, and mechanical royalties payable to third parties.

Royalties shall be computed and paid quarterly, within {{PAYMENT_DAYS}} days following the end of each calendar quarter (March 31, June 30, September 30, and December 31). Each payment shall be accompanied by a reasonably detailed statement showing the basis for the calculation of royalties due.

Royalties shall be computed and paid monthly, within {{PAYMENT_DAYS}} days following the end of each calendar month. Each payment shall be accompanied by a reasonably detailed accounting statement. Payments shall be made by electronic funds transfer to the account designated by Artist in writing.

Either party may terminate this Agreement for cause upon written notice if the other party: (a) commits a material breach of any provision of this Agreement and fails to cure such breach within {{CURE_PERIOD}} days after receipt of written notice specifying the breach in reasonable detail; (b) becomes insolvent, files for bankruptcy, or makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors; or (c) is convicted of a felony or engages in conduct that brings the other party into public disrepute.

Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience (i.e., without cause) upon {{CONVENIENCE_NOTICE}} days' prior written notice to the other party. In the event of termination for convenience by Label, Label shall pay Artist all royalties accrued through the effective date of termination within thirty (30) days thereof.

Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice if the other party: (a) files a voluntary petition in bankruptcy; (b) has an involuntary petition in bankruptcy filed against it that is not dismissed within sixty (60) days; (c) makes a general assignment for the benefit of its creditors; (d) has a receiver, trustee, or liquidator appointed for a substantial part of its assets; or (e) ceases to conduct business in the ordinary course.

Following termination or expiration of this Agreement, Label shall have a sell-off period of {{SELL_OFF_PERIOD}} months during which Label may continue to sell and distribute any physical inventory of the Works manufactured prior to the effective date of termination, subject to continued accounting and payment of royalties to Artist. After the sell-off period, Label shall destroy or return to Artist any remaining inventory, at Artist's election.

This Agreement may not be amended, modified, or supplemented except by a written instrument signed by both parties. No waiver of any provision of this Agreement shall be effective unless in writing and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. No failure or delay in exercising any right hereunder shall operate as a waiver thereof.

If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable by a court of competent jurisdiction, such invalidity, illegality, or unenforceability shall not affect any other provision of this Agreement, and this Agreement shall be construed as if such invalid, illegal, or unenforceable provision had never been contained herein. The parties shall negotiate in good faith to replace any invalid provision with a valid provision that achieves the original intent.

This Agreement may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Execution and delivery of this Agreement by facsimile, electronic mail (including PDF), or other electronic transmission shall be deemed to be, and shall have the same force and effect as, execution by original signature.
This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties hereto and their respective heirs, executors, administrators, legal representatives, successors, and permitted assigns.

As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below:

"Affiliate" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party.

"Catalog" means all sound recordings, musical compositions, and audiovisual works delivered by Artist to Label under this Agreement.

"Net Receipts" means the gross amounts actually received by Label from the exploitation of the Works, less (a) distribution fees, (b) platform commissions, (c) applicable taxes, (d) mechanical royalties payable to third parties, and (e) any returns, credits, or allowances.

"Territory" means {{OPP_TERRITORY}}.

"Term" means the period commencing on the Effective Date and continuing for the duration specified in the Term section of this Agreement.

This Assignment Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} by and between {{ACCT_LEGAL_ENTITY}} ("Assignor") and {{OPP_ASSIGNEE_ENTITY}} ("Assignee"), with respect to the assignment of certain rights and obligations under the original agreement dated {{OPP_ORIGINAL_AGREEMENT_DATE}} between Assignor and {{ACCT_COUNTERPARTY}} ("Original Agreement").

In consideration of this assignment, Assignee shall pay to Assignor an assignment fee of ${{OPP_ASSIGNMENT_FEE}} (the "Assignment Fee"), payable {{OPP_PAYMENT_TERMS}} following the execution of this Agreement. The Assignment Fee is non-refundable and shall be deemed fully earned upon execution.

This Assignment shall be effective as of {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} and shall remain in full force and effect for the duration of the Original Agreement, unless terminated earlier in accordance with the provisions herein. The territory covered by this Assignment shall be {{OPP_TERRITORY}}.

All royalties shall be payable {{OPP_PAYMENT_TERMS}} with accompanying statements.

Upon expiration, the license shall terminate and Licensee shall cease all exploitation of the New Work containing the sampled material, subject to a sell-off period of {{OPP_TERMINATION_PERIOD}} days.

This Termination Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{OPP_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} by and between {{ACCT_LEGAL_ENTITY}} ("Company") and {{ACCT_COUNTERPARTY}} ("Counterparty"), with reference to the original agreement between the parties (the "Original Agreement"). The parties desire to mutually terminate the Original Agreement upon the terms set forth herein.

The parties hereby agree that the Original Agreement shall be terminated effective as of {{OPP_TERMINATION_EFFECTIVE_DATE}} (the "Termination Date"). From and after the Termination Date, neither party shall have any further rights or obligations under the Original Agreement, except as expressly set forth in this Termination Agreement and except for obligations that by their nature survive termination.

Notwithstanding the termination of the Original Agreement, Company shall have a sell-off period of {{OPP_SELL_OFF_PERIOD}} months following the Termination Date during which Company may continue to sell or distribute existing inventory of products manufactured prior to the Termination Date. All revenues earned during the sell-off period shall be subject to the royalty and accounting provisions of the Original Agreement.

The following provisions of the Original Agreement shall survive the termination thereof: {{OPP_SURVIVING_OBLIGATIONS}}. All accounting obligations, including the obligation to render statements and pay royalties for periods prior to the Termination Date, shall remain in full force and effect.
